issues.problem: English has a missing sentence period: '...are bracketed insertions The editors note that...' — a punctuation slip, not a content difference
issues.suggestion: Change 'insertions The editors' to 'insertions. The editors'

issues.problem: The English adds two sentences of elaboration ('The President did not rush to fill the silence; the silence itself was entered into the official account alongside the words') that have no direct counterpart in the Chinese, though they restate the same idea already present in ZH
issues.suggestion: Optionally trim the English to the Chinese's single line 'The pause made it into the record.'

overall: The two editions match on all facts, dates, names, quotations, attributions and hedges; only a punctuation slip and one elaborative English aside are worth noting.
